Name: Abigail Sprite with Cat ears
Author: Winters381
Description:
Pretty much what it says on the tin.

Saw a portrait mod with cat ears and decided I wanted the sprite for Abigail.
Also her clothes are a weird corset-dress-thing. with a choker.

I don't make mods ever, but i did revisit this one and add the extra sprites.
went and content patcher'ified it - I'm pretty sure it works properly.

shouldn't need any more updates unless Abigail ends up with more sprites in an update. may or may not update this again if that happens, but such a thing seems unlikely.

The inspiration for this mod: Sakura's CAT GIRL mod.
https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1245
11/10, it's okay.

1.1 update: I went and added (only) the Abigail portraits from Sakura's mod to this one - a couple people missed the link above and asked for portraits.
The author unfortunately hasn't updated their mod for years. Though there's little need to, i suppose.
If you want the catgirl portraits for the other bachelorettes, go support the original artist.

The beach sprites are currently untested, but I don't see why they wouldn't work. let me know if they don't.
you can always edit the bikini colour in PAINT.NET if you don't like it - the colour is supposed to match her eyes(ish).
The beach portraits are an adaptation of the catgirl portraits from Sakura - apologies, i'm not much of an artist.

enjoy.
